Backend Engineer - Example Tech Ltd, Dhaka

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our growing platform team. You will design, build and operate the services that power our customer-facing products, working closely with product managers and frontend engineers.

Responsibilities
- Design and implement RESTful APIs in Python using FastAPI or Django.
- Model data in PostgreSQL and write efficient queries.
- Write automated tests and participate in code reviews.
- Deploy and monitor services using Docker and cloud infrastructure.
- Collaborate with the team to improve reliability and performance.

Requirements
- 2+ years of professional experience building backend systems.
- Strong knowledge of Python, SQL and HTTP fundamentals.
- Familiarity with Git, CI pipelines and containerised deployments.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work in a small team.

Nice to have: experience with message queues, caching layers and observability tooling.
